summary: R302 is a narrow Paper 24 printed-p233 source-style repair on top of R301. It changes two carried congruence/mod notation expressions back to the source-visible equals-zero parenthetical notation: `b^{(i)}G(x)=0(\frakm)` in section 1.4 and `b^{(i)}g(\xi)=0(\frakM)` in section 1.5. Formula (2) immediately below the first repaired sentence was already correct in R301. The cumulative German TeX/PDF builds with XeLaTeX and remains 474 pages.
